name: bucky
description: Compare markets, find lots that fit a buy box, check what a site allows, and prepare cited feasibility reports for land and buildings in Canada and the United States.

interface.shortDescription: Find sites that fit and see what you can build.
interface.longDescription: Compare markets on rents and vacancy, screen a covered city's lots against a buy box, and read why each lot matches. Check a site's zoning, permitted uses, and buildable envelope with the source behind each rule. Save sites to a project, run feasibility analysis, and prepare cited reports. Get the best localized data for your property work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check what I may be able to build at a specific address with cited zoning evidence.
